instruction: Candid documentary medium close-up of a ballet studio with a plain light grey wall and a wooden barre. The young girl in a black leotard (R1) stands on the left, holding the wooden barre with her right hand and looking up with a slight smile. The blonde instructor in a black long-sleeve top (R2) stands on the right, smiling as she holds the young girl's left leg high in a vertical stretch. The background is a plain light grey wall under bright, even indoor lighting that creates a clean, minimalist atmosphere.
